parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the gateway device.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the gateway device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the gateway device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description:
The page number from which to start displaying the response.

The total number of queried data entries cannot exceed 10,000. The value of **PageNo** cannot exceed the number of pages that can be displayed.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the gateway device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
